blocks.en:
In this paper, we evaluate open-source generative LLMs on legal Natural Language Inference (NLI). Legal inspectorial processes take place in specific domains and often deal with confidential data. This creates a need for working with local models that do not require labeled training data.
We evaluate our models on the ContractNLI benchmark and two NLI4Wills datasets. We successfully reproduce the baseline for the task (Span NLI BERT) and we evaluate multiple open-source LLMs on the same task. We analyze the invalid rate of the models, and their stability across temperature settings and domains.
Among the generative models, Gemma-4 26B performs the best, reaching an accuracy of 81.2%, even outperforming the supervised model on one metric. On accuracy, it is not possible to beat the supervised model with zero-shot approaches. Qwen-3.6 35B performs well on both ContractNLI and additional datasets in the legal wills domain.
Our findings indicate that zero-shot, open-source, generative LLMs are a viable alternative for real-world legal NLI when no supervised data is available. Our code is available at https://github.com/fbaratov/contractnli-llms .
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们评价关于法律自然语言推论(NLI)的开源基因LLMs。 法律检查程序是在具体领域进行的,往往涉及机密数据。 这就需要与不需要贴有标签的培训数据的地方模型合作。
我们用ContractNLI基准和两个NLI4Wills数据集来评估我们的模型. 我们成功地复制了任务的基线(Span NLI BERT),并在同一任务上评价多个开源有限责任公司。 我们分析模型的无效率, 以及它们在不同温度环境和域的稳定性。
在基因模型中,Gemma-4 26B性能最好,精度达到81.2%,甚至比被监督模型在一公分量上的表现要好. 关于准确性,不可能用零射入的方法来击败受监督的模型。 Quen-3.6 35B在ContractNLI和法律遗嘱领域的其他数据集上表现良好.
我们的研究结果表明,在没有监督数据的情况下,零射出、开源、遗传性有限责任公司是现实世界中合法国家液化指数的可行替代办法。 我们的代码可在https://github.com/fbaratov/contenli-llms上查阅。

blocks.en:
Document review is a task that
involves human experts investing considerable hours reading and reviewing a number of legal documents, and is a large burden on legal processes for organizations Nithya et al. (2024) . This includes government inspectorates, whose administrative inspections are heavily focused on document review for regulatory non-compliance detection.
As a result,
there has been an interest from inspectorates in applying computational methods to their inspections, hence reducing the workload for human experts.
blocks.zh:
文件审查是一项任务,
人类专家花费大量时间阅读和审查若干法律文件,对Nithya等人(2024年)组织来说,这是法律程序的沉重负担。 这包括政府监察部门,其行政监察工作主要集中于文件审查,以发现监管方面的违规行为。
结果
视察人员有意在视察中采用计算方法,从而减少了人类专家的工作量。

blocks.en:
One potential method for computer-assisted document review is natural language inference (NLI).
NLI is especially fitting to assist inspectors in their responsibility of reviewing documents with regards to government regulations in order to assess their regulatory compliance.
However, there are several obstacles in effectively integrating deep learning-based methods into inspectorial processes. First, inspections are expected to be confidential, meaning that API-based proprietary models would pose a security risk. Second, inspectorial processes take place in specific legal domains, such as education and transport, thus supervised methods require substantial data labeling for each newly presented domain. This issue is often exacerbated by the bureaucratic obstacles of gaining access to potentially viable data,
eliminating the option of extensive training or fine-tuning supervised methods.
blocks.zh:
计算机辅助文件审查的一个潜在方法是自然语言推论(NLI)。
NLI特别适合协助检查员审查有关政府规章的文件,以评估其遵守规章的情况。
然而,在将以深入学习为基础的方法有效纳入监察程序方面存在着若干障碍。 首先,检查应该是保密的,这意味着基于API的专利模型将构成安全风险. 第二,在教育和运输等具体法律领域开展了检查程序,因此,监督方法要求为每个新提出的领域贴上实质性的数据标签。 这一问题往往由于获取潜在可行数据的官僚主义障碍而加剧,
取消广泛培训或调整监督方法的选择。

blocks.en:
In this paper, we evaluate open-source LLMs on ContractNLI Koreeda and Manning (2021) , an English-language legal NLI dataset, to investigate the potential of these models in settings without labelled training data. Open-source LLMs are especially suited for our use case, as they (a) can be run locally, and can thus be trusted with sensitive documents, (b) can be used without extensive fine-tuning through zero-shot and few-shot learning, and (c)
have accessible inner workings, allowing them to convey predictive uncertainty.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们评价ContractNLI Koreeda和Manning(2021年)的开源LLMs(英语:ContractNLI Coreeda and Manning),这是一个英语的NLI法律数据集,以调查这些模型在没有标注培训数据的环境下的潜力. 开放源代码LLMS特别适合我们使用,因为它们(a)可以在当地运行,因此可以信任敏感文件;(b)可以通过零发和少发学习进行广泛的微调使用,以及(c)
拥有可获取的内在功能,使其能够传达预测性的不确定性.

blocks.en:
Our contributions are as follows: (1) We reproduce Koreeda and Manning (2021) ’s model for ContractNLI, Span NLI BERT, in order to verify their results and confirm it as a reliable baseline;
(2) We evaluate several state-of-the-art open-weight quantized LLMs on ContractNLI, finding that they do not meet the supervised results but reach reasonable accuracy (up to 81%) without any finetuning. We additionally assess generalizability to different legal domains by validating on the NLI4Wills dataset; (3) We conduct a temperature and logit-based stability analyses, finding that the models are robust against changes in temperature, but that logits for most models do not reliably reflect uncertainty.
blocks.zh:
我们的捐款如下: (1) 我们复制Koreeda和Manning(2021年)的ContractNLI、Span NLI BERT模型,以核实结果并证实其为可靠的基线;
(2) 我们评价了ContractNLI上若干最先进的可公开量级有限责任公司,发现它们不符合监督结果,但达到了合理的准确度(最高为81%),没有进行任何微调。 我们通过在NLI4Wills数据集上验证,进一步评估了不同法律领域的通用性;(3)我们进行了以温度和登录为基础的稳定性分析,发现模型与温度变化相比很强,但对大多数模型的对数并不能可靠地反映不确定性。

blocks.en: Hashemi Chaleshtori et al. (2024) conclude that, based on criteria such as task difficulty, as well as real-world risks and applications, ContractNLI is a good dataset for evaluating AI-assisted decision making. Multiple previous studies, such as Schuster et al. (2022) , and Tang (2023) , have evaluated models on the ContractNLI dataset. Narendra et al. (2024) present results based on GPT4 and a fine-tuned Mixtral implementation. However, they exclude the “NotMentioned” labels from their evaluation, as the focus of their study was on ContractNLI’s evidence identification task. Most recently, Liu et al. (2025) evaluated multiple proprietary and open-source LLMs on the CUAD dataset Hendrycks et al. (2021) , which focuses on identifying clauses relevant to a specific label. They find that, on this task, proprietary models generally outperform open-source models. They also find that results are improved by larger model size and reasoning capabilities, and that quantization negatively impacts performance. Their results indicate that open-source LLMs need to be fine-tuned to reach the performance of proprietary models. We put open-source zero-shot models to the test for a different task, legal NLI, to investigate their potential in domain-specific settings without labelled data for fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: 哈希姆·查列什托里等(2024年)得出结论,根据任务难度等标准以及现实世界的风险和应用,ContractNLI是评价AI协助决策的好数据集. 之前的多所研究,如Shuster等 (2022)和Tang (2023),在ContractNLI数据集上评价了模型. Narendra等人(2024年)介绍了基于GPT4和经过微调的Mixtral执行的结果. 但是,由于研究的重点是ContractNLI的证据鉴定任务,因此它们将 " 未注明的 " 标签排除在评估之外。 最近,刘等. (2025)在CUAD数据集Hendrycks等(2021)上评价了多专利和开源LLMs,该数据集侧重于识别与特定标签相关的条款. 他们发现,在这项任务中,专有模型一般都优于开源模型. 他们还发现,通过更大的模型规模和推理能力,结果得到了改进,量化对业绩产生了负面影响。 它们的结果表明,开放源代码LLMs需要进行微调以达到专有模型的性能. 我们把开源零镜头模型 测试不同的任务, 法律NLI, 调查它们的潜力 在特定域的环境下 没有标签的数据 微调。

blocks.en: Shorinwa et al. (2025) present an overview of current uncertainty quantification (UQ) methods, including white-box methods which assume that the model’s architecture is at least partially visible. Methods such as predictive entropy, proposed by Shannon (1948) and applied to deep learning by authors such as Gal and others (2016) and Ashukha et al. (2020) , also consider the output distribution of a given token by assessing the log-probabilities of every possible token.
blocks.zh: Shorinwa等人(2025年)概述了目前的不确定性量化方法,包括假定该模型的结构至少是部分可见的白箱方法。 香农(1948年)所提出并应用于Gal等人(2016年)和Ashukha等人(2020年)等作者深入学习的预测等方法,也通过评估每个可能信物的对数概率来考虑给定信物的输出分布.

blocks.en: In order to use generative LLMs for the NLI task, we apply the JSON output structures (see Appendix B ) during inference to improve inference quality and minimize invalid answer rates. The structures consist of a free-text “explanation” field, followed by a “classification” field that outputs one of the dataset labels. We choose this order so that the explanation will be in the model’s context window when it generates a label. This way, the LLMs initially generate a free-text explanation that can be read and interpreted by a human user, and then summarize the outcomes of this explanation into a single label.
blocks.zh: 为了将基因LLMs用于NLI任务,我们在推论中应用了JSON输出结构(见附录B)来提高推论质量并尽量减少无效的回答率. 结构由一个自由文本“解释”字段组成,然后是输出一个数据集标签的“分类”字段。 我们选择这个顺序是为了当模型生成标签时,解释会放在模型的上下文窗口中. 这样,LLMS最初生成一个自由文字解释,可以被人类用户读取和解释,然后将这个解释的结果总结为单一的标签.

blocks.en: We evaluate on two prompts, provided in Appendix A , that closely resemble those used by Narendra et al. (2024) . These prompts are relatively simple and allow for the face-value evaluation of LLM performance, focusing more on their inherent capability to handle the challenge posed by our datasets, and less on how performance can be increased through prompt engineering.
blocks.zh: 我们评价附录A中提供的与纳伦德拉等人(2024年)所用的非常相似的两个提示。 这些提示相对简单,可以对LLM性能进行面值评价,更注重其应对我们数据集所构成挑战的固有能力,而较少关注如何通过即时工程提高性能.

blocks.en: We use two of the token-level white-box UQ methods compiled by Shorinwa et al. (2025) : Average negative log-probability and maximum negative token log-probability 1 1 1 Shorinwa et al. (2025) refer to these metrics as “average log-probability” and “maximum token log-probability” respectively. The equations themselves use negative log-probability. Therefore, we refer to them differently for added clarity. (Appendix C for equations).
blocks.zh: 我们使用由Shorinwa等人(2025年)汇编的两种符号级白盒UQ方法: 平均负对数概率和最大负对数概率1 1 Shorinwa等人(2025年)分别将这些指标称为“平均对数概率”和“最大对数概率”。 等式本身使用负对数概率. 因此,为了更加明确起见,我们以不同的方式提及它们。 (等式附录C).

blocks.en:
We focus on ContractNLI 2 2 2 https://stanfordnlp.github.io/contract-nli/ Koreeda and Manning (2021) to evaluate our models. ContractNLI is a document-level NLI dataset which defines legal contracts as premises, and a set of 17 different statements as hypotheses.
The dataset contains 607 contracts to be used as premises for the NLI task, with each contract containing annotations for 17 hypotheses.
The annotations include an NLI label for whether the document entails, contradicts, or is unrelated to the hypothesis.
We use the test set of 123 documents for our experiments. It contains a total of 2091 document-hypothesis samples, 1188 of which are labelled either “Contradiction” or “Entailment”, and 903 are labelled “NotMentioned”.
blocks.zh:
我们的重点是ContractNLI 2 2 2 https://stanfordnlp.github.io/Contract-nli/ https://stanfordnlp.github.io/ Contract-nli/. Koreeda和Manning(2021年)评价我们的模型. ContractNLI是一个文件级的NLI数据集,它将法律合同定义为房地,而一套由17个不同报表构成的假设.
数据集包含607个合同,作为NLI任务的场所,每个合同包含17个假设的说明.
说明中包括一个NLI标签,说明文档是否引起,与假设相矛盾,或与假设无关.
我们用123个文件的测试组做实验 它共包含2091个文件伪证样本,其中1188个标有"封装"或"尾"等标签,903个标有"封装"等标签.

blocks.en: The NLI4Wills datasets 3 3 3 https://github.com/ml4ai/nli4wills-corpus/tree/main/data Kwak et al. (2023) are legal NLI datasets that focus on evaluating the validity of legal will statements in the US states of Idaho and Tennessee. Three inputs are provided: a statement from a will, a condition, and a law. The task is to evaluate whether the law and condition support , refute , or are unrelated to the given statement. NLI4Wills consists of two datasets: NLI4Wills-Idaho and NLI4Wills-Tennessee. NLI4Wills-Idaho contains 154 input samples, and NLI4Wills-Tennessee contains 255 input samples.
blocks.zh: NLI4 威尔斯数据集 3 3 3 https://github.com/ml4ai/nli4wills-corpus/tree/main/data 互联网档案馆的存檔,存档日期2013-12-21. Kwak等人(2023年)是美国爱达荷州和田纳西州的法律NLI数据集,专注于评价法律意志声明的有效性. 提供了三项投入:遗嘱声明、条件和法律。 任务是评估法律和条件是否支持、反驳或与特定声明无关。 NLI4 数字 Wills由两个数据集组成:NLI4 Wills-Idaho和NLI4 Wills-Tennesee. NLI4 Wills-Idaho包含154个输入样本,而NLI4 Wills-Tennessee包含255个输入样本.

blocks.en: To reproduce the Span NLI BERT baseline introduced by Koreeda and Manning (2021) , we utilize the code and instructions provided by the authors on GitHub. 4 4 4 https://github.com/stanfordnlp/contract-nli-bert We were able to train the model provided by the authors with no significant problems and with minimal changes to the code itself.
blocks.zh: 我们利用作者在GitHub上提供的代码和指示, 我们得以培训作者提供的模型,没有重大的问题,并且对代码本身的修改很少。

blocks.en: We evaluate models of varying sizes from four different language families: Gemma-4 (E2B, E4B, 26B) Gemma Team, Google DeepMind (2026) , Ministral-3 (3B, 8B, 14B) Liu et al. (2026) , Qwen-3.5 (4B, 9B, 27B) Qwen Team (2026a) , and Qwen-3.6 (35B) Qwen Team (2026b) . These model families are primarily chosen for their recency and variance in size, which will allow us to compare models from the same family or models of similar sizes. We run all models larger than 20 billion parameters in reasoning mode, as we expect that their larger size will allow them to make better use of reasoning mode when quantized compared to smaller models.
blocks.zh: 我们评价来自四个不同语言家族的大小不同的模型:Gemma-4(E2B,E4B,26B)Gemma Team,Google DeepMind (2026),Ministal-3 (3B,8B,14B) 刘等 (2026年),出道于出道于出道于出道于出道于出道于出道于出道于出道于出道于出道于出道于出道于出道于出道于出道于出道于出道于出道于出道于出道于出道于出道于出道于出道于出道于出道于出道于出道于出道于出道于出道于出道于出道于出道于出道于出道于出道于出道于出道于出道于出道于出道于出道于出道于出道于出道于出道于出道于出道于出道于出道于出道于出道于出道于出道于出道于出道于出道于出道于出道出道于出道于出道出道于出道于出道出道于出道于出道于出道出道出道于出道于出道出道出道于出道出道于出道于出道于出道于出道出道于出道出道 这些模范家庭主要选取的是它们的容貌和大小差异,这可以让我们比较同一个家庭的模型或大小相近的模型. 我们在推理模式中运行了所有大于200亿个参数的模型,因为我们期望它们更大的尺寸会使它们在与更小的模型相比被量化时能够更好地利用推理模式.

blocks.en:
We set the temperature to 0.3 for all models to encourage differences in explanations across seeds, while still keeping stochasticity low enough to keep classifications reliable. We provide output structures for all models except Gemma-4 26B to follow (see Appendix B ).
We set context windows to 16,384 tokens, and limit the outputs to 5,000 tokens.
blocks.zh:
我们规定所有模型的温度为0.3,以鼓励不同种子的解释差异,同时保持较低的花样来保持分类的可靠性。 除了Gemma-4 26B外,我们为所有模型提供输出结构(见附录B)。
我们设置了16 384个上下文窗口,并将输出限制在5 000个上下文。

blocks.en: We use Ollama to conduct our experiments. All models use 4-bit quantization. As a result, all models can comfortably run on relatively inexpensive consumer-grade hardware.
blocks.zh: 我们用奥拉玛来做实验 所有模型都使用4位量化. 因此,所有模型都能够舒适地运行在相对便宜的消费级硬件上.

blocks.en:
We use the three NLI metrics proposed by Koreeda and Manning (2021) : the contradiction F1-score F1(C), entailment F1-score F1(E), and overall model accuracy. We micro-average these scores over documents and then macro-average them over labels. We evaluate our results against Span NLI BERT for the all-label setting. Because generative models sometimes lead to invalid output, we modify the evaluation script provided by Koreeda and Manning (2021) to handle invalid LLM outputs
by treating them as incorrect. For all datasets, we report the mean and standard deviations of metrics over three seeds, as well as invalid output rates.
blocks.zh:
我们使用由克来达和曼宁(2021年)提出的三个NLI度量衡:相矛盾的F1-分数F1(C),包含F1-分数F1(E),以及整体模型精度. 我们在文件上得到的微平均值 然后在标签上得到宏观平均值 我们比照Span NLI BERT来评估我们的结果 来设定所有标签 因为基因模型有时会导致无效输出,我们修改了由Koreeda和Manning(2021年)提供的评审脚本来处理无效的LLM输出.
以不正确的态度对待他们。 对所有数据集,我们报告三颗种子的度量平均与标准差,以及无效输出率.

blocks.en:
Temperature analysis We repeat our evaluation for each model on several temperatures between 0.1 and 0.5. Comparing metrics between various temperature settings will help us assess the models’ robustness against changes in temperature. Uncertainty analysis For each model-label-seed combination, we perform a Mann-Whitney U Test Mann and Whitney (1947) to determine whether the distribution of uncertainty metrics for correct answers is stochastically less than the distribution of uncertainty metrics for incorrect answers.
We use Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery control Benjamini and Hochberg (1995) and calculate effect sizes using Rank Biserial Correlation Wendt (1972) .
We evaluate primarily only on the logits of the label. We also provide results on (a) the logits of the whole answer and (b) the logit of the label’s first token (Appendix F ). NLI4Wills validation To assess generalizability to other legal domains, we evaluate the best performing configurations for each model on the NLI4Wills datasets. Following Kwak et al. (2023) , we report results on Precision, Recall, F1-scores, and Accuracy.
blocks.zh:
温度分析 我们重复我们对每个模型的评价,在0.1至0.5之间的若干温度。 对比不同温度环境的衡量标准将有助于我们对照温度变化评估模型的稳健性。 对于每个模型-标签-种子组合,我们进行Mann-Whitney U Test Mann和Whitney(1947年)的不确定性分析,以确定正确答案的不确定性度量的分布是否比错误答案的不确定性度量的分布略低.
我们使用Benjamini-Hochberg假发现控制Benjamini和Hochberg(1995年),使用Rank Biserial Correlation Wendt(1972年)计算效果大小.
我们主要只评估标签的日志。 我们还就(a) 整个答案的对数和(b) 标签的第一个符号(附录F)的对数提供结果。 NLI4 遗嘱验证 为了评估其他法律领域的通用性,我们评价NLI4Wills数据集上每个模型的最佳性能配置。 继克瓦克等人(2023年)之后,我们报告了精度、回溯、F1-分数和准确性的结果。

blocks.en: Ablation study We perform an ablation study for reasoning and structured outputs on all reasoning-capable models (Appendix H ).
blocks.zh: 读取研究 我们对所有能够推理的模型进行推理和结构化产出的研究(附录H)。

blocks.en: Table 1: Reproduction results for Span NLI BERT. “Re-Or” indicates the reproduction’s gain or loss over the values reported by Koreeda and Manning (2021) (‘K&M’). O.SD and R.SD indicate whether the difference is less than or equal to the original standard deviations reported by the authors or the reproduction’s standard deviations respectively.
blocks.zh: 表1:Span NLI BERT的复制结果。 " Re-Or " 表示繁殖损益超过Koreeda和Manning(2021年)( " K&M " )。 O.SD和R.SD表示差异是否小于或等于作者分别报告的原始标准偏差或复制标准偏差.

blocks.en: Table 2: Results on three-way classification. Boldface indicates the best-performing model per metric, and the “Invalid Rate (%)” column indicates the average percentage of answers outputted by the LLM from which we were unable to retrieve a coherent label. The green row highlights the best-performing LLM.
blocks.zh: 表2:三向分类结果。 Boldface 表示每个公尺的性能最好的模型,而“无效率(%)”一栏则表示我们无法从 LLM 中获取一致标签的答案的平均百分比。 绿色一行突出表现最好的LLM.

blocks.en: The values we report in Table 1 are very close to those reported by Koreeda and Manning (2021) . For all metrics except F1(E), our results are within one standard deviation from those reported by the authors. For F1(E), our reproduction scores 0.008 less than the values reported by Koreeda, a difference of about 1%. As our reproduction has results very close to those reported by the authors on all metrics, we consider the method to have been successfully reproduced.
blocks.zh: 我们在表1中报告的数值与科雷达和曼宁(2021年)报告的数值非常相近. 除了F1(E)之外,所有衡量标准,我们的结果都与提交人所报告的标准差在一个标准范围内。 对于F1(E),我们的再生得分比克来达报告的值低了0.008分,相差约1%. 由于我们的复制结果与作者报告的所有衡量标准非常相近,我们认为这种方法已经成功复制。

blocks.en:
Our main results on three-way classification are in Table 2 .
We find that all models outperform the majority baseline. None of the models reach the performance of the fine-tuned Span NLI BERT on Accuracy and F1(E). However, several models match or surpass its performance on F1(C).
Of the tested LLMs, Gemma-4 26B performs best on all metrics, outperforming Span NLI BERT on F1(C) and outperforming all other models on other metrics.
Qwen-3.5 27B achieves a slightly worse, but still similar, performance to Gemma-4 26B. Qwen-3.6 35B performs noticeably worse than these two models on most metrics, but still outperforms several other models.
For medium-sized models (8B-14B parameters), Qwen-3.5 9B yields the best performance on overall accuracy and F1(E). On F1(C), it is outperformed by Ministral-3 14B. Ministral-3 8B overall has the lowest scores on metrics.
Among small models (2B-4B), Qwen-3.5 4B outperforms all other generative models on F1(C). Ministral-3 3B reports the lowest results out of all models, performing worse on all metrics compared to the similarly-sized Gemma-4 E2B and Qwen-3.5 4B.
blocks.zh:
我们关于三向分类的主要结果见表2。
我们发现所有模型都超过了大多数的基线。 这些模型都没有达到精细的Span NLI BERT在精确性和F1(E)上的性能. 然而,有几种型号在F1(C)上与它的性能相匹配或超越.
在经过测试的LLMs中,Gemma-4 26B在所有度量衡上表现最好,在F1(C)上表现优于Span NLI BERT,在其他度量衡上表现优于所有其他模型.
Quen-3.5 27B的性能与Gemma-4 26B的性能稍差,但仍相类似. Quen-3.6 35B在大多数度量衡上的性能明显比这两个模型差,但仍然优于其他几个模型.
对于中型模型(8B-14B参数),Quen-3.5 9B在总体精度和F1(E)上产生最佳性能. 在F1(C)上,其表现被Ministry-3 14B所超越. 总体来说,Ministry-3 8B的衡量标准分数最低。
在小模型(2B-4B)中,Quen-3.5 4B在F1(C)上超越了所有其他基因模型. Ministry-3 3B报告在所有模型中结果最低,在所有度量衡上的表现都比类似大小的Gemma-4 E2B和Quen-3.5 4B差.

blocks.en: Invalid answer rates are very low across all models. All non-reasoning models have a 0.0% invalid answer rate, with the exception of Qwen-3.5 4B, which has a 0.1% invalid answer rate. Interestingly, the best performing model, Gemma-4 26B, has the highest invalid answer rate, with 1% of its answers not containing a valid label.
blocks.zh: 在所有模型中,无效的回答率都非常低. 所有不合理的模型都有0.0 %的无效回答率,只有Quen-3.5 4B例外,它的无效回答率为0.1%. 有趣的是,表现最好的模型Gemma-4 26B的无效回答率最高,其1%的回答没有包含有效的标签.

blocks.en: The temperature analysis reveals that the tested models are largely robust against changes in temperature. Accuracy and F1(E) barely changes across all models, with F1(C) showing the most change. These changes can be attributed to the much smaller number of contradiction labels in the dataset. This imbalance would result in small changes in the number of correctly classified contradictions having a noticeable effect on F1(C). See Appendix E (Figure 1 ) for detailed results.
blocks.zh: 温度分析显示,所测试的模型在温度变化时基本坚固. 准确性和F1(E)在所有模型中几乎没有变化,其中F1(C)显示的变化最大. 这些变化可以归因于数据集中矛盾标签的数量要少得多. 这种不平衡会导致正确分类的矛盾数量发生小幅变化,对F1(C)产生显著影响. 详细结果见附录E(图一)。

blocks.en: Table 3: Uncertainty analysis summary for the main results (Table 2 ) on the label-only scope. ✓ indicates tests on all 3 seeds are significant ( p ~ i < 0.05 \tilde{p}_{i}<0.05 ). × \times indicates otherwise.
blocks.zh: 表3:只标范围主要结果的不确定性分析摘要(表2). ✓表示对所有3个种子的测试都是显著的 (p ~ i < 0.05\tilde{p}_{i}<-}<0.05 ). ×\时间表示相反.

blocks.en: The Mann-Whitney U Tests for the label-only analysis (Table 3 ) indicate that, for most tested models, average negative log-probability and maximum negative log-probability do not reliably reflect answer correctness. The tests for Gemma-4 E2B and Gemma-4 E4B all have significant p ~ i \tilde{p}_{i} -values for prediction token logits across all seeds and ground truth labels, suggesting that their output label logits are sufficiently aligned with predictive uncertainty.
blocks.zh: Mann-Whitney U Tests用于标签唯一分析(表3)表明,对于大多数被测试的模型,平均负对数概率和最大负对数概率不能可靠地反映答案正确性. Gemma-4 E2B 和 Gemma-4 E4B 的测试都具有显著的p ~ i\tilde{p}_{i} - 在所有种子和地真标签上预测符号对数的值,说明其输出标签对数与预测不确定性充分一致.

blocks.en: Some models have significant p ~ i \tilde{p}_{i} -values on several tests, with Qwen-3.5 27B doing so on most label-only tests. However, it fails to achieve significant p ~ i \tilde{p}_{i} -values across all seeds.
blocks.zh: 一些模型有显著的 p~i\tilde{p}_{i} - 价值在几个测试上, Quen-3.5 27B在大多数只有标签的测试上这样做。 然而,它未能实现显著的p~i\tilde{p}_{i} - 所有种子的价值。

blocks.en:
The results do not suggest a wider, generalizable trend between models of the same parameter counts or families.
Detailed results are available in Appendix F .
blocks.zh:
结果表明,在相同参数计数模式或家庭模式之间,趋势并不广泛。
详细结果见附录F。

blocks.en: Our cross-domain evaluation on the NLI4Wills datasets shows that Qwen-3.6 35B is the best-performing LLM on these datasets. However, it falls short of the RoBERTa-based baseline results reported by Kwak et al. (2023) on the Tennessee dataset. Detailed results are shown in Tables 36 and 37 in Appendix G .
blocks.zh: 我们对NLI4Wills数据集的跨域评价显示,Quen-3.6 35B是这些数据集上表现最好的LLM. 然而,它没有达到克瓦克等人(2023年)在田纳西州数据集上报告的基于RoBERTa的基准结果. 详细结果载于附录G表36和表37。

blocks.en: The best-performing settings per model are shown in Table 4 . The ablations on Gemma-4 models do not have a large effect on the accuracy, but F1(C) scores on the smaller models tend to be higher for the reasoning-only settings. This difference is less noticeable for Gemma-4 26B, where scores between reasoning-only and structure-only are mostly the same.
blocks.zh: 每个模型的绩效最好的设置见表4。 在Gemma-4模型上的活化对精度没有很大影响,但是在更小的模型上的F1(C)分数对于仅推理设置来说往往更高. 对于Gemma-4 26B来说,这种差异不太明显,因为只有推理和只有结构的分数大多是相同的.

blocks.en:
Qwen-3.5 models tend to have a very high invalid output rate ( 12 − 69 % 12-69\% ) when for the reasoning-only ablation. This results in a much lower model accuracy compared to other settings. The invalid output rate decreases greatly when both structures and reasoning are used, and becomes negligible ( ≤ 0.1 % \leq 0.1\% ) for the structure-only ablation.
Qwen-3.6 35B performs best across all metrics in the reasoning-only ablation while maintaining a very low invalid output rate.
blocks.zh:
Quen-3.5型机型在为推理唯能衰减时往往具有非常高的无效输出率(12–69%-12-69\%). 这导致模型精度远低于其他设置. 无效输出率在既使用结构又使用推理时会大幅下降,对于仅用于结构衰减的可忽略不计(^0.1%\leq 0.1\%).
Quen-3.6 35B在仅用于推理的减速中,在所有度量中表现最好,同时保持了非常低的无效输出率.

blocks.en: Table 4: Ablation study – best setting per model. Boldface indicates the best-performing model per metric. The IR (%) column corresponds to the invalid answer rate. Subscripts correspond to standard deviations. The green row highlights the best-performing LLM.
blocks.zh: 表4: 校正研究 – 每个模型的最佳设置. 粗体字表示每公分量的性能最好的模型. IR (%) 一栏对应无效的回答率. 下标对应标准偏差. 绿色一行突出表现最好的LLM.

blocks.en: Across all models, using structured outputs and reasoning simultaneously rarely results in higher scores compared to using only one of the two, nor does it result in lower invalid output rates. Detailed results are available in Appendix I .
blocks.zh: 在所有模型中,使用结构化产出和推理同时很少产生比仅使用两者之一更高的分数,也不产生较低的无效产出率. 详细结果载于附录一。

blocks.en:
In this paper, we successfully reproduced Span NLI BERT, and investigated the performance of ten zero-shot LLMs in three model families on the NLI task of the ContractNLI dataset.
We found that the best performing LLM is Gemma-4 26B with an accuracy of 81.2%, scoring 5.7% below the supervised model. Qwen-3.6 35B shows promising results on both the ContractNLI and NLI4Wills datasets.
This indicates that although zero-shot open-source generative quantized LLMs underperform fine-tuned models on ContractNLI, they are a viable alternative in settings without any labelled data.
As next steps, we plan to bring our models to the inspectorates’ work practice to evaluate them for other languages and subdomains. Additionally, we will experiment with UQ methods, including the use of reasoning capabilities to provide explanations for the generated label.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们成功地复制了Span NLI BERT,并调查了三个模组家庭中10个零镜头LLMs在ContractNLI数据集NLI任务上的性能.
我们发现,性能最好的LLM是Gemma-4 26B,精度为81.2%,比被监督模型低5.7%。 Quen-3.6 35B显示,ContractNLI和NLI4Wills数据集都取得了有希望的成果。
这表明,虽然在ContractNLI上零发开源基因化的LLMS未实现精细调整模型,但是在没有任何标注数据的设置中,它们是一种可行的替代品.
作为下一步,我们计划将我们的模式带入监察部门的工作实践中,以评价其他语言和子领域。 此外,我们将试验UQ方法,包括使用推理能力来解释生成的标签。

blocks.en: We test a good number of LLMs, all quantized via Ollama, but adding more models is always possible. Therefore, the results we present may not be representative of all quantized models’ performance on this task.
blocks.zh: 我们测试了大量的LLM,全部通过Ollama进行定量,但增加更多的模型总是可能的. 因此,我们介绍的结果可能不能代表所有量化模型在这项任务上的业绩。

blocks.en: Our study mostly uses a fixed configuration for variables such as reasoning modes, structures, and prompts. Therefore, our results are non-exhaustive, and we do not make claims on the performance of our setup compared to alternate configurations for the same models.
blocks.zh: 我们的研究主要使用一个固定的配置,用于诸如推理模式,结构和提示等变量. 因此,我们的结果不是详尽无遗的,我们并不就同一模型的替代配置对设置的绩效提出主张。

blocks.en: While our experimental procedures and temperature settings prevent label predictions generated by the LLM from being misaligned from the generated explanations, the stochastic nature of such models means that this is still a small possibility. As a result, different seeds and temperatures may result in small variations in classification even if the input and explanation remain the same. We expect that this does not have a meaningful effect on results.
blocks.zh: 虽然我们的实验程序和温度设置防止由LLM生成的标签预测与生成的解释错配,但这种模型的花样性意味着这仍然是一个很小的可能性. 因此,不同的种子和温度可能导致分类的细微变化,即使输入和解释保持不变. 我们期望这不会对结果产生有意义的影响。

blocks.en: We have not been able to find any legal NLI datasets with documents longer than ContractNLI, which has a maximum document length of about 12,000 tokens. All datasets used contain inputs that fit comfortably into our LLMs’ context windows, and using methods for handling very lengthy documents was not necessary for our experiments. Therefore, our results are not representative of these models’ performance on very lengthy documents that exceed their context windows, or their performance when combined with methods explicitly designed for handling very long documents.
blocks.zh: 我们无法找到任何文件长于ContractNLI的合法NLI数据集,ContractNLI的最大文件长度约为12,000个令牌. 所使用的所有数据集都含有与我们的LLMS上下文窗口相适应的输入,使用处理非常长的文件的方法对我们的实验是不必要的。 因此,我们的结果不能代表这些模型在超过上下文窗口的冗长文件中的表现,也不能代表这些模型在与明确用来处理冗长文件的方法相结合时的表现。

blocks.en: Our work is intended to assist experts in their decision-making processes by providing them with helpful tools. We do not seek to design systems that replace experts, especially given the risky nature of the regulatory domain. We maintain regular communication with several inspectorates, and ensure that the experts and the inspectorates as a whole are aware of this.
blocks.zh: 我们的工作旨在通过向专家们提供有用的工具,协助他们的决策进程。 我们并不寻求设计替代专家的系统,特别是考虑到监管领域的风险性质。 我们与几个监察机构保持经常的沟通,确保专家和整个监察机构了解这一点。
